facts_of_case: The parties are Som Raj and Seema Rani. The respondent-wife filed a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was prayed to be transferred from the trial court to another jurisdiction.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes amicably and file a joint petition for divorce.
legal_principles.held: The parties have settled their dispute out of Court and have amicably decided to file a joint petition under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: Respondent can withdraw a pending petition to enable parties to file a joint petition.
legal_principles.held: The respondent-wife undertakes not to press the above noticed petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, registered as HMA/724/2023 titled as Seema Rani vs. Somraj, pending in the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Kurukshetra and further to withdraw the same.

outcome.final_order: The parties have settled their dispute out of Court and will file a joint petition under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, for dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce by mutual consent.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for a divorce case
advising on amicable settlements in family disputes
preparing a joint petition under Section 13-B
